name: app-shell
title: App shell: layouts, list/detail and agent layer
description: AppShell with three layouts. B "workspace" puts a ListDetail on a screen (phone: the list, then the detail as a stack step with Back; wide: a 20rem list and the detail side by side, sidebar as an icon rail). C "chat" wraps the app's own AgentWorkspace (untouched, passed as the nav item's render; install the pi-app item yourself) in the same sidebar, account menu and header; it takes no shell agent. A "screen": one screen at a time, every screen kept mounted. On a phone bottom tabs (at most four; more give three plus a « Plus » sheet) and an avatar button that opens the account sheet; on a wide screen the shadcn sidebar (icon rail, NavUser). One header per screen through useScreenHeader (title, subtitle, back, up to two actions, the rest behind « … »). The account menu holds « Améliorer l'app » (the improve agent), the app's own entries and sign out. AppSheet is the one bottom sheet (one open at a time, Back closes it). It mounts the AgentLayer: one agent's PiChat above the app (phone: a drawer with peek, half and full snap points; wide: a right panel), the improve agent in the same layer, optional push-to-talk and point mode. Also useAgentContext and readAgentContext (the screen on show travels as `context` with each submit) and useBackLayer, the one Back manager. Built on explicitly pinned Base UI drawer and dropdown-menu recipes, plus the sidebar and avatar of the host's own shadcn style.
